Chapter 1 - JManager Reference / JManager Functions
Runtime Invocation Functions /

JMCloseSession

Ends a Java runtime session and removes the allocated JMSessionRef object. 
OSStatus JMCloseSession (JMSessionRef session);
session
The session to be removed.
DISCUSSION
A successful call to JMCloseSession also frees any resources allocated by JManager. However, any resources that you explicitly allocated on behalf of JManager must be explicitly deallocated.

SEE ALSO
The JMOpenSession function (page 21).
